full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the respondent No.1 as plaintiff having filed Title Suit No.405 of 1984 before the Sub. Judge, 10 Court, Dhaka for Specific Performance of Contract against one Giribala Dasi alleged Sebayiet of Sree Sree Modon Mohan Goura Netai Debo Bigraha obtained an exparte decree and got sale deed executed by the Court on 06.01.1987 and thereafter, filed title execution case and obtained delivery of possession and filed Miscellaneous Case No.133 of 1990-91 for mutation before the Assistant Commissioner of Land, Kotwali Circle, Dhaka and thereafter, the petitioner as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 167 of 1991 for setting aside the aforesaid exparte judgment and decree alleging that the said decree was obtained by fraud and also misleading the Court and also prayed for permanent injunction therein and the said case has been transferred to Sub Judge, 2nd Commercial Court, Dhaka which was renumbered as Title Suit No. 20 of 1993 and thereafter, the said suit was again transferred to joint District Judge, Additional Court, Dhaka which was renumbered as Title Suit No. 217 of 2003 and the defendant-respondent filed an application under order 7 Ride 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of plaint on the point of maintainability and learned Court rejected the same on 29.02.2004 and against the aforesaid order defendant No.1 as petitioner filed Civil Revision No.163 of 2004 before the District Judge, Dhaka which was heard by 7th Additional District Judge, Dhaka who allowed the Revision on 28.08.2004 and thereafter, this petitioner preferred Civil Revision No. 4554 of 2004 before the High Court Division who issued Rule and thereafter, the petitioner filed application for injunction in which Rule was issued but finally the High Court Division discharged both Rules.
